description: Replace Bash outputs larger than 50 KB by their first 8 KB (updatedToolOutput with the full Bash output shape) so the model never ingests the whole blob.
usage: Opt-in (not in the default profile). Merge into .claude/settings.json. The script is installed in .claude/hooks/ by install-common-rules.sh and needs jq or node. For a softer, advisory variant see output-size-hint.sh (default profile).
